def sort_array(arr):
 if len(arr) <= 1:
  return arr
 mid = len(arr) // 2
 left = sort_array(arr[:mid])
 right = sort_array(arr[mid:])
 result = []
 i = j = 0
 while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
  if left[i] < right[j]:
   result.append(left[i])
   i += 1
  else:
   result.append(right[j])
   j += 1
 result.extend(left[i:])
 result.extend(right[j:])
 return result
